meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: Claude 可以搜索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库,按「搜索→时间线→取详情」三步走:先给出带 ID 的索引表,再围绕某条记录看前后上下文,最后只取你选中记录的完整内容。
howto.when: 当你提到「之前解决过吗」、「上次 X 是怎么做的」等关键词,或需要查看过去会话的工作记录时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下之前会话里关于认证的记录
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的索引表

say.text: 上次那个 token 过期的问题是怎么修的?
say.note: 先搜到相关记录,再取完整详情

say.text: 把 #11131 前后几条记录按时间顺序列出来
say.note: 用 timeline 看该记录前后的上下文

howto.what_en: Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory. It follows a three-step flow: search to get an index table with IDs, view a timeline of context around one entry, then fetch full details only for the IDs you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?" or need work from previous sessions.

say_en.text: Search past sessions for records about authentication.
say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs first

say_en.text: How did we fix the token expiration bug last time?
say_en.note: Finds matching records, then fetches full details

say_en.text: Show the records around #11131 in chronological order.
say_en.note: Uses timeline to show context around that entry
